lhs: Declared shape from width-two ReduceWindow on explicitly edge-padded [n,3] (optionally converted).
rhs: Inferred shape of emitted ReduceWindow on original base with base-dilation-scaled edges, under the same retained result annotation.
conditions: Nonnegative symmetric one-cell first-axis Pad edges, no interior, static rank two, both kernel bounds two, stride and kernel dilation one, first base dilation positive, no preexisting window padding. Counterexample n=0, first base dilation two. Compatible scalar zero fill/init; converted path S16 to S32. The pinned XLA padding and stride helper bodies were subsequently inspected; a full optimizer pass or native verifier was not run.
types: Static signed integer arrays and exact mathematical output extents. Source-shaped direct-handler profile.
overlap: Prior empty_high_formula_refuted gives the one-axis geometry; this two-axis adapter and direct/converted dispatch mapping are timed separately. Operand-first HandlePad can remove the source pattern.

lhs: F32 forward rank-three convolution with input width three, kernel width four, padding (0,1), ascending spatial taps and one output.
rhs: Convolve the reversed old kernel against the old input with new window reversed, width three and signed padding (-1,0).
conditions: Layout insensitive, swap option enabled, groups one, no sparsity or scaling, dense parameter tensors, one spatial axis, unit strides/dilations, original reversal false, singleton batch/features, two DEFAULT precision fields and a successful lowerable callback. Kernel-product benefit is 4>3.
types: Finite nonnegative exactly represented input integers through 2^24, strict binary32 RNE multiply and accumulating addition from positive zero; no required backend reduction schedule.
overlap: Different terminal from pointwise/reduce convolution-to-multiply or integer type profiles: an exact operand exchange reverses the order of spatial products.

lhs: Flatten a transposed 2×2 input into a length-four contraction and multiply in ascending index order.
rhs: Flatten the original input and apply the inverse axis transformation to the constant tensor before contracting.
conditions: One side is the transposed parameter, the other a nonuniform vector constant; modeled strict binary32 RNE. Both operand orientations. Finite nonnegative integers up to 2^24 and weights 0,1,2.
types: Binary32 values, fixed sequential contraction order; no backend-independent equivalence claim.
overlap: Existing associative exact dot and other numerical discrepancies do not test transferring the contracting-axis transpose onto the constant.

lhs: Pad the feature axis, flatten two outer dimensions and gather on the resulting row dimension.
rhs: Flatten the unpadded operand, gather with the full unpadded feature extent and then pad that output axis.
conditions: Static compatible dense [p,q,n] and [p*q,m] shapes, signed edge/interior padding, legal bitcast-compatible reshape, one indexed row axis and pass-through full feature axis. Start clamped, width within row extent.
types: Arbitrary cell values and legal finite coordinates. Empty observations are explicit.
overlap: The direct gather-of-pad case omits the rank-changing reshape and changed gather slice size; the same decoder and clamping function are reused.
